description:
Analyze a jstack / jcmd Thread.print dump: thread states, pools, lock contention, identical stacks, CPU time, and deadlocks found from the lock graph itself (knowing Object.wait() releases its monitor). Returns the verdict-first text summary plus the structured analysis.

Returns: The text summary (verdict first: deadlocks, then states, contention, pools, identical stacks, CPU), plus structured counts.
Example input: {"text":"\"main\" #1 prio=5 os_prio=31 cpu=29.70ms elapsed=3.18s tid=0x0001 nid=0x2703 waiting on condition  [0x0001]\n   java.lang.Thread.State: TIMED_WAITING (sleeping)\n\tat java.lang.Thread.sleep(Native Method)\n\tat Main.main(Main.java:19)\n"}
On error, includes hint: Paste the whole dump, including the 'Found one Java-level deadlock' section when present; deadlocks are also derived independently from - locked / - waiting to lock lines.

text.description: The thread dump text (jstack, jcmd Thread.print, or a SIGQUIT print).

name: jvm_thread_dump
title: Analyze a JVM thread dump
